description.fun: Togedemaru is a spiky ball of a hedgehog with a lightning-bolt needle on its head that works as a lightning rod. Its own electricity doesn't go far, so on stormy days groups gather with their needles held high, waiting to be struck. When it's happy it curls into a ball and rolls around out of control, and it often tries to steal Elekid's electricity, usually fighting to a draw.
description.guide: Togedemaru is an Electric- and Steel-type Pokémon from Alola based on a hedgehog. It gathers electricity with the needle on its head, even from lightning strikes. In Alola, a Totem Togedemaru guards Sophocles's trial at Hokulani Observatory.
description.tagline: A spiky hedgehog that stands in storms to catch lightning
